# ALTCHA widget (vendored)

Self-hosted copy of the ALTCHA widget (version in `altcha.min.js.VERSION`), taken from the
official `altcha-django` 1.1.0 wheel (MIT license, https://altcha.org). It is served by this
application, so the browser never contacts an external CDN.

- `altcha.min.js` : widget bundle (custom element `<altcha-widget>`).
- `altcha.min.js.SRI` : the bundle's SRI hash, for reference.
- `i18n/all.js` : translations, including Persian (`language="fa"`).

To update: download a newer release of the same package and replace these files together.
